basis: User explicitly directs all authorized ready work including reviews and integration to start, and rejects injecting new instructions into started browser chats.
clarification: A closed packet fixes full scope, contracts, producer identities, ownership and completion duties. It does not require future contracted producer outputs to exist before the consumer starts. Reading new output from an already-contracted producer is part of the original mission, not late instructions.
rules: Assign each consumer its whole closure responsibility and the complete known producer set before startup, including ready and in-flight outputs. Pin ready outputs by SHA; for in-flight outputs pin producer/epoch/paths/contracts and require immutable terminal SHA/prepost on admission.
Consumers independently reconcile GitHub outputs in their original contracted scope. No new chat message or comment is required to receive an output already included in their startup mission.

No milestone-only closure assignments. Integration owns all contracted source intake, dependency closure, consumer reconciliation and candidate composition. CI owns all scoped queues and eventual accepted-candidate final suites. Reviewers own full assigned review and causal rechecks while active. Each duty remains bounded by actual host/resource controls.
Start all independent implementation, test-driver preparation, integration preparation, reviews and evidence work concurrently. Do not hold work for arbitrary waves or global green.

Retain only real precedence: missing source/contract, exclusive writer or dispatcher, actual installed identity/runtime, accepted same-C for final proof, immutable evidence provenance. Do not claim those dependencies are solved by documents/fixtures.

Do not inject revised remit into already-started sessions. Preserve their original mission/authority. Fresh closure successors receive this complete policy and all contracted inputs upfront, after reliable ownership handoff; no inference of death or concurrent accepted writer.
GitHub comments remain NOTICE_ONLY. A handoff/readback/consumer receipt establishes actual consumption; no fiction that a browser chat was steered.

No reduction of15WPs/74tasks/1610criteria/17contracts or UX scope. GLOBAL_RELEASE still requires product consumers, AM01–06, same-C finalCI/gates, independent approvals, validD/C-G7/D-G8 and remote proof.
